name: 08867 · Pittstown, NJ
findings: ZIP 08867 (Pittstown) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08867 (Pittstown) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 08867 (Pittstown) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
